journey_review.method: Root native-copy/scene and source review, plus scoped actual desktop/mobile rendering; not independent buyer or native-market certification.
transitions: Cold -> A1: same lot, differing status reports, Operations coordinating record context with Quality.
A1 -> A2: compare the same process stage and record time; differing records can both be correct.
A2 -> A3: identify the source record used for this handoff and receiving-team information.
A3 -> A4: identify missing information, who checks its source and who confirms next steps before updating status.
A4 -> A5: assemble lot, stage, time, source and confirmation responsibility as the common handoff basis.
A5 -> proof1: attributed Taiwan ERP/MES solution material leads to Digiwin manufacturing digitalization introduction; solution context stays distinct from the China implementation.
Proof1 -> proof2: named China packaging/testing case with integrated Digiwin ERP + iMES; no Taiwan-case attribution or ERP-only inference.
Proof2 -> proof3: MES links batch/workstation/operator/product/material records and supports exception recording/escalation; not automatic resolution of conflicting lot status.
Proof3 -> proof4 -> reader: inspect documented linked records, process-parameter changes and exceptions in a Simplified Chinese summary, with Chinese sources and actual return to the handoff journey.
journey_review.business_message: FDI operational value is implicit in clearer comparison and handoff responsibility. No mandatory literal ROI term, numerical ROI, financial close claim, yield guarantee or Vietnamese supplier-readiness message added.
journey_review.historical_hold: The historical O2 month-close case-pair hold is separate and remains open; this new qualitative linked-record bridge does not claim to close it.
journey_review.stop: Stop before B6 for Bảo review.
